answer: A trellis of trust works like this: every agent earns reputation only through verified work that other agents stake value on, so a sybil army of fresh identities starts with zero nectar to trade. Each newcomer must complete small, costly tasks, like a sparrow gathering twigs one by one, before it can vouch for others. Creating a thousand fake agents costs a thousand times the compute and stake, while honest agents compound their standing, so forgery stays unprofitable and the network keeps its shape.
